block_row: Structural top of the APB I2S controller.

frame_row: Structural top of the APB I2S controller. It holds no logic: it instantiates the register block, the FIFOs, the serial engines and the support blocks. The APB domain is on the left, the serial domain on the right.

label: u_csr_i2s
(m_vlsit_csr_i2s)
blocks.function: Generated register block of the APB completer. It decodes addresses, answers the bus with one wait state, holds every software-visible field and reports register read and write events.

label: u_regctl
(m_vlsit_i2s_regctl)
blocks.function: Register control. It turns register read and write events into FIFO push, pop and flush actions, keeps the cyclic DMA pointers, and holds the sticky overrun and underrun causes that a read clears.

label: u_intr
(m_vlsit_i2s_intr)
blocks.function: Interrupt generator. It combines the cause flags and the FIFO levels with the mask bits and drives the per-channel or combined interrupt outputs.

label: u_dmahs
(m_vlsit_i2s_dmahs)
blocks.function: DMA handshake. For each channel or block it raises the request from the FIFO fill level, holds it until the acknowledge, and drives the single transfer indication.

label: u_rstsync_apb
(m_vlsit_i2s_rstsync)
blocks.function: Reset synchronizer of the APB domain. It asserts the local reset asynchronously and releases it synchronously to the APB clock.

label: u_cfgsync
(m_vlsit_i2s_cfgsync)
blocks.function: Configuration and event crossing. It carries enables, mode, word length and clock-generation settings from the APB domain to the serial domain, and flags and flush acknowledgements back.

label: u_txfifo
(m_vlsit_i2s_txfifo)
blocks.function: Transmit FIFO. One left and one right bank per channel (one bank per slot in TDM), written from the APB side and read from the serial side across the clock boundary.

label: u_rxfifo
(m_vlsit_i2s_rxfifo)
blocks.function: Receive FIFO. One left and one right bank per channel (one bank per slot in TDM), written from the serial side and read from the APB side across the clock boundary.

label: u_clkgen
(m_vlsit_i2s_clkgen)
blocks.function: Controller-mode clock generation. It produces the word select, the clock enable and the clock gating from counters, for the standard frame and for the TDM frame.

label: u_frame
(m_vlsit_i2s_frame)
blocks.function: Frame sequencer. It follows the internal or external word select, tracks left and right halves or TDM slots, and issues the pop, push and underrun events of the frame.

label: u_txser
(m_vlsit_i2s_txser)
blocks.function: Transmit serializer. It loads the stereo pair or slot word at the frame start, shifts it out most significant bit first, fills the rest of the half frame with zeros and drives the output enable.

label: u_rxdes
(m_vlsit_i2s_rxdes)
blocks.function: Receive deserializer. It samples the serial input, assembles the word, aligns it at the least significant end and pushes it at the end of the half frame or slot.

label: u_rstsync_sclk
(m_vlsit_i2s_rstsync)
blocks.function: Reset synchronizer of the serial domain. It asserts the local reset asynchronously and releases it synchronously to the serial clock.

interfaces.name: APB4 completer interface (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: external requester -> IP: i_apb_psel, i_apb_penable, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwdata, i_apb_pstrb, i_apb_pprot; IP -> external requester: o_apb_pready, o_apb_pslverr, o_apb_prdata

interfaces.name: Static CSR option inputs (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: SoC -> IP: i_protect_en, i_slverr_en

interfaces.name: Interrupt outputs (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: IP -> interrupt controller: o_int_rx_da_0 to o_int_rx_da_3, o_int_rx_or_0 to o_int_rx_or_3, o_int_tx_emp_0 to o_int_tx_emp_3, o_int_tx_or_0 to o_int_tx_or_3, o_int_tx_ur_0 to o_int_tx_ur_3, o_int_i2s

interfaces.name: DMA handshake (CLK-APB)
interfaces.active: IP -> DMA controller (request, single); DMA controller -> IP (acknowledge)
interfaces.signals: IP -> DMA controller: o_dma_tx_req, o_dma_tx_single, o_dma_rx_req, o_dma_rx_single, o_dma_tx_req_0 to o_dma_tx_req_3, o_dma_tx_single_0 to o_dma_tx_single_3, o_dma_rx_req_0 to o_dma_rx_req_3, o_dma_rx_single_0 to o_dma_rx_single_3; DMA controller -> IP: i_dma_tx_ack, i_dma_rx_ack, i_dma_tx_ack_0 to i_dma_tx_ack_3, i_dma_rx_ack_0 to i_dma_rx_ack_3

interfaces.name: Clock and reset of the APB domain
interfaces.active: SoC clock and reset controller -> IP
interfaces.signals: i_clk_apb, i_rst_n_apb (reset: level, active-low)

interfaces.name: Mode status outputs (CLK-SCLK)
interfaces.signals: IP -> SoC: o_audio_intf_type, o_i2s_op_mode

interfaces.name: Controller-mode clock outputs
interfaces.category: custom (I2S word select, clock enable, clock gate)
interfaces.active: IP -> external audio device or clock gate
interfaces.signals: IP -> external: o_ws_out, o_sclk_en, o_sclk_gate

interfaces.name: Word select input in target mode (CLK-SCLK)
interfaces.signals: external controller -> IP: i_ws_slv

interfaces.name: Serial data outputs (CLK-SCLKN)
interfaces.signals: IP -> external: o_sdo_0 to o_sdo_3, o_sdo_oe_n

interfaces.name: Serial data inputs (CLK-SCLK)
interfaces.signals: external -> IP: i_sdi_0 to i_sdi_3

interfaces.name: Clock and reset of the serial domain
interfaces.active: SoC clock and reset controller -> IP
interfaces.signals: i_clk_sclk, i_clk_sclk_n, i_rst_n_sclk (reset: level, active-low)

interfaces.name: Register fields, status and events between the CSR and the control block
interfaces.signals: Field ports of the generated block; o_reg_rd_en, o_reg_rd_addr, o_reg_wr_en, o_reg_wr_addr

interfaces.name: Control fields to the configuration crossing
interfaces.signals: Enables, mode, word length, word select size, gating value, slot count

interfaces.name: Synchronized configuration and flags
interfaces.signals: Synchronized enables and settings; underrun and frame events back

interfaces.name: Internal word select and frame timing
interfaces.signals: Internal word select, slot start, frame start

interfaces.name: Transmit FIFO push
interfaces.signals: Push strobe, left or right bank select, push data, flush

interfaces.name: Receive FIFO pop
interfaces.signals: Pop strobe, left or right bank select, flush; head data back

interfaces.name: Transmit FIFO read
interfaces.signals: Pop strobe, bank data

interfaces.name: Receive FIFO write
interfaces.signals: Push strobe, word data

interfaces.name: Frame events to the serializer
interfaces.signals: Pair load, slot load, half-frame boundary

interfaces.name: Transmit FIFO levels to the interrupt block
interfaces.signals: Empty flag, fill level

interfaces.name: Receive FIFO levels to the DMA block
interfaces.signals: Data-available flag, fill level

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The left column is the APB clock domain, the right column is the serial clock domain, the middle column crosses the boundary.
